title: JWT signature verification disabled in python — review required
description: The decode options set verify_signature to False, so the token payload is trusted without checking who signed it. Anyone can mint a token with any subject or role and the application accepts it. The rule flags the explicit option; a verifier that is genuinely disabled elsewhere is a review decision.
remediation: Leave signature verification enabled, pin an explicit algorithm allowlist, and validate issuer, audience and expiry on every decode.
limitation: Lexical: matches the explicit option assignment on one line; custom verifier wrappers are out of scope.
